nextStoryContext: US-003 ports tmux.ts + monitor.ts. Key points: use Bun.$ for tmux capture-pane invocations; expose processOneTick(deps) with injectable dependencies (time, tmux capture, sleep, logger, config) for unit-testability. No real tmux spawned in tests. Builds on src/retry/patterns.ts (isRateLimited, findRateLimitMessage), src/retry/time-parser.ts (parseTime), src/retry/config.ts (loadConfig/RetryConfig), and src/retry/logger.ts (createLogger/Logger). Watch for Bun.$ error handling — it throws on non-zero exit; wrap tmux capture in try/catch.

officialDocsValidated.summary: Bun.TOML.parse(str) parses TOML v1.0 string into JS object; throws BuildMessage (extends Error) on invalid TOML. Implementation catches via err instanceof Error and surfaces path + message. API confirmed matches implementation.
